RANZ-26 · Close the day · evidence run

Close the day trial record

Branch feat/close-the-day at 36b96e9 (PR #72), run 2026-09-25 16:36:06 UTC to 2026-09-25 16:45:59 UTC.

(a) Verdict

Verdict

PASS WITH GAPS — all 21 cases passed; 73 of 88 edge-case rows evidenced, 0 flaky, 0 unverified, 15 deferred or out of scope by design; 3 states were not exercised and are listed in (e) as UNVERIFIED.

21 cases · 21 passed · 0 failed · 1 stalled once and was re-run. Edge-case rows: 73 evidenced · 0 flaky · 0 failing · 0 unverified · 15 deferred or out of scope.

Corrections during this run: One product defect found and fixed: A4 showed a desk whose session expired with the dialog open the generic refusal, 'This day cannot be closed right now…', which blames the day. closeBusinessDay now redirects to sign-in (36b96e9); A4 was re-run against the fix and its first screenshot is kept. Nothing was written on that path either way. Two of the run's own expectations were wrong and were corrected, both recorded under their cases: A3 assumed another Property's id would fall back to one the viewer reaches (main's HK-S1-24 shows nothing instead), and the first E2 captioned a quiet day as having items open — caught by reading its screenshots back, rewritten on a fresh Property and re-run.

(b) Environment

Code under testfeat/close-the-day at 36b96e9 (PR #72; origin/main 673097a merged in at 6f85092). The browser cases A1–A3, B1–B5, C1, D1, E1 and E2 and the suites Z2–Z3 ran at 6f85092; 36b96e9 adds only migration 005200 (a guard arm no screen reaches) and the expired-session fix A4 found. A4 ran at 36b96e9 and Z1 was re-run after 005200 was applied to this database (business_day_close 1..59); A4's first run, at 3a93100, is kept under the case.
WorkspaceProduction build (next build, then next start) on http://localhost:3118
Workerapps/worker built with esbuild (pnpm --filter worker build) and run as node apps/worker/dist/main.mjs, only inside case D1, then stopped with SIGTERM
DatabaseA throwaway ranza-postgres container, ranza-close-evidence-pg, on port 54399: created empty, pgtap installed, every migration applied with prisma migrate deploy, local role passwords set. Nothing else used it.
BrowserHeadless Chromium from @playwright/test in the recorder's own process, 1360×860 viewport. No MCP browser, no shared browser.
AccountsSigned in through the real sign-in form: deniz@example.test (manager, seeded by goals/…/bin/seed-lane.mjs through the app's sign-up route) and six evidence accounts made the same way — owner@, desk@ (front_desk), finance@, housekeeping@, auditor@ (the Organization's own 'Night auditor' role: front_desk.check_in and check_out, no front_desk.close_day) and remote@ (manager, assigned to one Property only).
FixturesEach state has a Property of its own, created in SQL and dated from app.property_today(): bookings for last night, a Guest past departure, a departed Guest's open Folio, and earlier closes. Past-dated states cannot be produced through the screens without the clock moving, so they are written directly; every action a person takes in a case is taken through the browser. Earlier closes are written in replica mode, as the tests do.
TimeEvery Property on Europe/Istanbul with the 04:00 cutoff; the run was on 2026-09-25 local, so 'yesterday' is 2026-09-24.

(c) What was tested

Every row of docs/features/close-the-day/edge-cases.csv (88 rows), with the cases and the assertions that speak to it. A row is PASS only when a browser case in this run or a test run against this run's database names it and passed; otherwise it is UNVERIFIED, whatever the CSV says. A test is credited to a row only when its title contains the row's test_name.

Not tested (3)

  • UNVERIFIED — A timeout or a lost connection while closing. The action logs an unexpected error with console.error and answers the generic refusal; no case forced one.
  • UNVERIFIED — Many of each thing at once beyond what the fixtures hold (two bookings not arrived, one Guest past departure, one Folio left open, a backlog of four). No case loads dozens of rows.
  • UNVERIFIED — The worker running continuously: D1 ran one pass (about 61 s) and stopped it. Repeated passes, overlap and shutdown mid-pass are covered only by Z2/Z3 (CD-S2-13, CD-S2-16), not by this run's process.

Stalls

  • A2-finance — Re-run once after a stall on the first attempt (page.waitForURL: Timeout 90000ms exceeded.).

Observations outside this branch

  • Arabic renders dates and counts in Western digits (“24 سبتمبر 2026”, “04:00”), as the rest of the workspace does; not asserted either way by this feature.
  • A Folio left open by a departed Stay with no booking is listed by its room (“R-F1”), because the fixture Stay has no Guest; a Stay made through check-in carries its Guest's name.
  • Finance and housekeeping reach Close the day in the rail and see the checklist without a Close button — CD-S1-43's 'a viewer who cannot close', as designed.
  • The worker's one pass closed five quiet days across the database, not only this run's quiet Property (“due 8, closed 5, waiting on their desk 3, failed 0”): it closes every due quiet day at every Property, which is the design (CD-S2-01).
  • The ADR number 0034 is also used by an uncommitted file in the shared checkout (all inner pages have a back button); it is on no branch, so it does not collide on main yet.
  • The same generic-refusal answer to a missing session exists in main's finance.ts and accommodation.ts actions; it is outside this branch and was not changed here.

(f) Repro steps

  1. The recorder, its role setup and this generator are lane tooling kept outside the repository (goals/ is untracked; a copy is kept in the worktree's git directory, .git/worktrees/ranza-close-day/evidence-backup). The steps below name them; the product code they drive is all on the branch.
  2. sh goals/2026-09-24-close-the-day/evidence/fresh-pg.sh ranza-close-evidence-pg 54399; create extension pgtap; DIRECT_URL=postgresql://ranza:ranza@localhost:54399/ranza prisma migrate deploy; alter role ranza_app/ranza_auth/ranza_worker with login password = its name.
  3. In apps/operator-workspace, with goals/…/evidence/evidence.env exported (every URL on 54399, BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3118): next build, then next start --port 3118. pnpm --filter worker build.
  4. SEED_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://ranza:ranza@localhost:54399/ranza WORKSPACE_URL=http://localhost:3118 node goals/…/bin/seed-lane.mjs; then node goals/…/evidence/setup-roles.mjs.
  5. EVIDENCE_OUT=<run dir> node goals/…/evidence/record.mjs (ONLY=A3,E2 re-runs named cases against the same fixtures).
  6. node goals/…/evidence/generate.mjs <run dir> docs/evidence/close-the-day/trial-record.html goals/…/evidence/env.json
